prompt: Professional premium rigid packaging photography, one CONSISTENT product in a strict 3-column 2-row contact sheet, 3:2 overall. Six equal square cells, no borders/captions/text/logo. Cell6 blank. Product Skincare ritual, Magnetic book box. A rigid lid hinges at the spine; concealed magnets close the front edge. Paper-wrapped rigid greyboard, Fine linen-textured wrapping paper, Midnight blue and silver, Two-colour print and debossed border, fine abstract wave pattern. EMPTY insert: a jar well beside two bottle wells. Cell1 CLOSED full 3/4 hero. Cell2 OPEN: Show lid attached on LEFT spine, open flat beside base. Thin paper hinge, magnets hidden. No tuck flaps. Cell3 closed rear/side same design. Cell4 overhead close view of the SAME empty insert inside base. Cell5 close paper/finish/corner detail. All views same proportions, artwork locations, number and shape of insert cavities. Neutral warm studio, tactile paper, refined controlled lighting. Never a corrugated mailer, tuck carton, dust flaps or shipping box. Realistic separate assembled rigid walls, straight edges, accurate mating footprints and visible paper thickness. Keep complete objects within each cell. No products inside; focus on the packaging. In detachable structures never prop the lid against the base or stand it behind it; rest it flat alongside with a clear empty gap.
